The Chinese characters for Anna

As a transliteration, Anna is usually written 安娜 (Ān nà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

安
Ān
peace, safe
娜
nà
elegant (in names)

Origin and meaning

The name Anna has Hebrew roots and means “grace”.

About the name Anna

A timeless name carried by heroines of literature and by many saints.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “grace”, an Anna calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
